basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and gamer based in Portland, Oregon. My interests range from retro gaming consoles like the Sega Saturn to modern MMO gaming. I work as a junior IT support specialist, and in my downtime, I enjoy exploring new tech gadgets and peripherals. I'm currently single and usually online during late evenings after work. I have a keen interest in podcasting and recently started my own tech podcast.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in Information Technology with a focus on hardware and peripherals. I completed a diploma in IT and have been self-teaching through online courses and community engagement. My current job in IT support has given me hands-on experience with a variety of tech equipment.
